objective: Require the documented code execution/file-creation capability before custom Skill upload and use.
scenario: The owner cannot find the custom Skills upload option in Claude Settings.

input.preflight: Check Settings > Capabilities; enable Code execution and file creation (or Create and edit files in updated UI); review workspace policy if applicable

expected_behaviors: Check the feature prerequisite before troubleshooting the ZIP.
Distinguish Skill enablement from Project instructions and Project knowledge.
Recommend Safari at claude.ai if the iPad app does not expose the management controls, while noting UI variation.
prohibited_behaviors: Assume the Skill is active without visible confirmation.
Recommend bypassing organization or safety policies.
